name: telegram-channel
description: Talk to a Codex session through your own Telegram bot, with local access control.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to a Codex session through a Telegram bot.
interface.longDescription: Messages sent to your Telegram bot arrive in the Codex session you have open, and Codex answers in the same chat. Access is pairing- and allowlist-based and is managed only from your terminal. Runs on Bun with no other dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Show the status of my Telegram channel
Configure the Telegram channel with my BotFather token
Pair the Telegram code my bot sent me
